from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, os

pptx = Path('/home/user/workspace/out_b/Safety_Brief.pptx')
icons = Path('/home/user/workspace/in_b/icons')
slides = [
    ('Personal Protective Equipment', 'SAF-01', 'Wear a fitted helmet, eye protection, and task-appropriate gloves before entering the work area.', 'icon_helmet.png'),
    ('Recognize and Report Hazards', 'SAF-02', 'Stop work, isolate the area, and report spills, exposed wiring, or unstable loads to the shift lead.', 'icon_hazard.png'),
    ('Keep Emergency Exits Clear', 'SAF-03', 'Keep exit routes and door swing areas clear; use the nearest marked exit during an alarm.', 'icon_exit.png'),
]
P='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'
A='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
R='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
PKG='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
CT='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types'
ET.register_namespace('a', A)
ET.register_namespace('p', P)
ET.register_namespace('r', R)

def tag(ns, name): return '{%s}%s' % (ns, name)

def serialize(root):
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as z:
    items = {n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

for n, (title, footer, body, iconfile) in enumerate(slides, 1):
    slide_path=f'ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml'
    root=ET.fromstring(items[slide_path])
    tree=root.find('.//'+tag(P,'spTree'))
    placeholder=None
    hint=None
    for sp in list(tree):
        if sp.tag != tag(P,'sp'): continue
        c=sp.find('./'+tag(P,'nvSpPr')+'/'+tag(P,'cNvPr'))
        if c is None: continue
        name=c.get('name','')
        if name == f'Title_{n}':
            text=sp.find('.//'+tag(A,'t'))
            text.text=title
        elif name == f'Body_{n}':
            text=sp.find('.//'+tag(A,'t'))
            text.text=body
        elif name == f'Footer_{n}':
            text=sp.find('.//'+tag(A,'t'))
            text.text=footer
        elif name == f'IconPlaceholder_{n}':
            placeholder=sp
        elif name == f'IconHint_{n}':
            hint=sp
    if placeholder is None: raise RuntimeError(f'no placeholder {n}')
    if hint is not None: tree.remove(hint)
    # Reuse the placeholder's designed tile and place an inset transparent PNG above it.
    rel_id='rId2'
    pic=ET.Element(tag(P,'pic'))
    nv=ET.SubElement(pic,tag(P,'nvPicPr'))
    c=ET.SubElement(nv,tag(P,'cNvPr'), {'id':'8','name':f'SafetyIcon_{n}'})
    picpr=ET.SubElement(nv,tag(P,'cNvPicPr'))
    ET.SubElement(picpr,tag(A,'picLocks'), {'noChangeAspect':'1'})
    ET.SubElement(nv,tag(P,'nvPr'))
    blipfill=ET.SubElement(pic,tag(P,'blipFill'))
    ET.SubElement(blipfill,tag(A,'blip'), {tag(R,'embed'):rel_id})
    stretch=ET.SubElement(blipfill,tag(A,'stretch'))
    ET.SubElement(stretch,tag(A,'fillRect'))
    sppr=ET.SubElement(pic,tag(P,'spPr'))
    xfrm=ET.SubElement(sppr,tag(A,'xfrm'))
    # Existing tile geometry: x=8,366,760; y=1,828,800; 2,331,720 square.
    # Center a 2.2 inch square image in the 2.55 inch square tile.
    size=2011680
    offset=(2331720-size)//2
    ET.SubElement(xfrm,tag(A,'off'), {'x':str(8366760+offset),'y':str(1828800+offset)})
    ET.SubElement(xfrm,tag(A,'ext'), {'cx':str(size),'cy':str(size)})
    geom=ET.SubElement(sppr,tag(A,'prstGeom'), {'prst':'rect'})
    ET.SubElement(geom,tag(A,'avLst'))
